cues.text:
Every golf fan
knows this hole.

Almost none have
seen it from here.

Bring the people
who deserve it.

tracks._line: Tremaine... this for birdie, at seventeen. (Barrett preset, loudness -25, rate -10, pitch -1)

tracks._note: generated gallery roar, 12 s; its attack sits at 4.4 s so the swell leads the drop at 20.0 and the peak lands at 20.15

tracks._line: No experience like the TripNerd experience. (owner's cloned voice, element 'me')

_note: v5 (first pass) used the same shots with the earlier plain-delivery Barrett lines (Whitlock, wordier make line), roar at 19.9 with fade-in, c1 at 0.6; v5b is the recommended master.
